config.label: Default Frida device ID to use (e
config.description: Default Frida device ID to use (e.g. emulator-5554 or a USB serial). Can also be set with --device.

config.label: Set to "1" to enable execution of custom Frida scripts (execute_script and custom hook_function handlers)
config.description: Set to "1" to enable execution of custom Frida scripts (execute_script and custom hook_function handlers). Disabled by default.

config.label: Set to "1" to enable the write_memory tool
config.description: Set to "1" to enable the write_memory tool. Disabled by default for safety.

config.label: Set to "1" to enable the inject_library tool (loads a native
config.description: Set to "1" to enable the inject_library tool (loads a native .so/.dylib into the target via Frida's injector). Disabled by default.

config.label: Set to "1" to enable the adb_shell tool (arbitrary shell commands on an Android device via adb)
config.description: Set to "1" to enable the adb_shell tool (arbitrary shell commands on an Android device via adb). Disabled by default.

config.label: Set to "1" to use V8 script-runtime snapshots to speed up repeated script loads (requires FRIDA_MCP_RUNTIME=v8)
config.description: Set to "1" to use V8 script-runtime snapshots to speed up repeated script loads (requires FRIDA_MCP_RUNTIME=v8). Disabled by default.

config.label: Set to "0" to stop persisting every tool result (params, status, structured result) to the evidence store; "1" forces it on
config.description: Set to "0" to stop persisting every tool result (params, status, structured result) to the evidence store; "1" forces it on. Enabled by default.

config.label: Directory of the evidence store (records at <path>/YYYY-MM-DD/<evidence_id>
config.description: Directory of the evidence store (records at <path>/YYYY-MM-DD/<evidence_id>.json plus index.jsonl, mode 0600). Defaults to ~/.config/frida-mobile-mcp/evidence.

config.label: Size cap of the evidence store in MB; oldest records are pruned beyond it
config.description: Size cap of the evidence store in MB; oldest records are pruned beyond it. Defaults to 200.

config.label: host[:port] of a remote frida-server to add as a remote device at startup (port defaults to 27042)
config.description: host[:port] of a remote frida-server to add as a remote device at startup (port defaults to 27042).

config.label: Auth token of the remote frida-server in FRIDA_MCP_REMOTE (frida-server --token)
config.description: Auth token of the remote frida-server in FRIDA_MCP_REMOTE (frida-server --token).

config.label: Path to the PEM certificate of a TLS remote frida-server in FRIDA_MCP_REMOTE (frida-server --certificate)
config.description: Path to the PEM certificate of a TLS remote frida-server in FRIDA_MCP_REMOTE (frida-server --certificate).

config.label: Tool schema profile
config.description: Tool schema profile. "compact" shortens tool schemas and descriptions for clients with small context windows.

config.label: Tool exposure profile
config.description: Tool exposure profile. "core" registers only 32 core tools to keep the tool catalog small next to other MCP servers.

config.label: Comma-separated tool-name globs that are never registered, e
config.description: Comma-separated tool-name globs that are never registered, e.g. "adb_*,frida_server_*".

config.label: Maximum number of characters in a single tool response; longer output is truncated
config.description: Maximum number of characters in a single tool response; longer output is truncated.

config.label: Bearer token required by HTTP clients
config.description: Bearer token required by HTTP clients. Only used with --transport http (required when --host is not loopback); unused for the default stdio transport.

config.label: Frida script runtime to use for injected agents
config.description: Frida script runtime to use for injected agents.

config.label: Set to "1" to enable debug logging on stderr
config.description: Set to "1" to enable debug logging on stderr. Can also be set with --debug.

config.label: Directory with prebuilt Java/ObjC bridge bundles (defaults to dist/bridges inside the package)
config.description: Directory with prebuilt Java/ObjC bridge bundles (defaults to dist/bridges inside the package)

config.label: Cache directory for the frida
config.description: Cache directory for the frida.Compiler project used to compile ES module scripts

config.label: Path to a friTap fritap_agent
config.description: Path to a friTap fritap_agent.js bundle for capture_tls (otherwise the installed friTap Python package or a pinned download is used)

config.label: friTap release tag to download when no local agent is found (default v2
config.description: friTap release tag to download when no local agent is found (default v2.6.5)

config.label: Bare sha256 of the downloaded friTap agent for the selected FRITAP_VERSION tag
config.description: Bare sha256 of the downloaded friTap agent for the selected FRITAP_VERSION tag. v2.6.5 is pinned in the package; set this for other tags.
